rows.heading: Study Leave Eligibility & Approval
rows.quote_snippet: 6.3 Maximum Duration: The maximum duration of study leave that may be granted during an executive's entire service shall be 24 (twenty-four) months. This may be extended to a maximum of 36 months for an approved doctoral research program (Ph.D.) with the specific sanction of Director (HR). 6.4 Competent Sanctioning Authority: Study leave within India shall be sanctioned by Director (HR); study leave outside India shall require the approval of the Chairman & Managing Director (CMD).
